skill_route.resolution: The mission-approved production registry entry and TC-FF6-MACH-001 bind complete ProductContract obligation slices to format-feature-expansion. The historical reconciler's TESTED label was rejected because it mapped unrelated analytics symbols to the diff capability.

requested_operation: implement a stable-cell-identity notebook diff with minimum move detection, field-distinguished reports, explicit ignore policies, and atomic machine-applicable patches guarded by logical-base preconditions

inputs.root_cause: The package had analytics queries but no structural diff or patch model. The historical contract reconciler incorrectly credited IPYNB-DIFF-001 from unrelated get_* symbols, so repeated runs could preserve a TESTED label without any move detection, ignore policy, patch precondition, or executable patch behavior.
inputs.affected_layer: IPYNB pure model, public API, version-control workflow, preservation behavior, and package documentation

defect_reproduction.outcome: Test collection failed because format_factory.ipynb exported no CellField, diff_notebooks, patch type, or patch-precondition error.

implementation.identity: Both notebooks must provide unique non-empty cell IDs. Added, removed, moved, and modified cells are reconciled by ID rather than position.
implementation.move_detection: An O(n log n) longest-increasing-subsequence calculation returns a minimum deterministic moved-cell set. Insertions and removals do not create move noise for unchanged common order.
implementation.field_model: Cell changes separately report cell type, source, metadata, attachments, execution count, outputs, and unknown fields; notebook-level fields are reported independently. Presence flags distinguish a missing member from explicit JSON null.
implementation.policy: DiffPolicy can ignore outputs, execution counts, and named transient metadata keys. The same projection controls both reporting and patch preconditions.
implementation.patch: NotebookPatch stores a defensive complete target snapshot and a SHA-256 logical-base fingerprint. Apply is non-mutating and atomic; a visible concurrent change raises PatchPreconditionError before producing a result.
implementation.ignored_value_preservation: Policy-ignored values are restored from matching existing cells during patch application. Values are not copied across cell-type or output-type changes, and complete target values remain on newly added cells.
implementation.input_integrity: Complete source and target documents must be finite JSON-compatible values even when a policy would hide a field.
implementation.unknown_data: The target snapshot preserves unknown JSON members exactly; no renderer, executor, or schema coercion is invoked.
implementation.tradeoff: A patch retains a complete target snapshot, so patch memory is proportional to target document size. This is intentionally traded for atomicity and unknown-field fidelity; compact operation serialization remains a future optimization and is not claimed.
